title: UpdateAccountRequest
description:
Changes an account.

Every field is optional and an absent one means "leave this alone". The password is not here: it has its own request, because changing one is a different act with different authority behind it.

Role.description:
What an account is allowed to do.

Ordered by authority, so `>=` is a meaningful test and [`Role::may_administer`] is the only place that decides what that means.

oneOf.description:
Drives the show: everything Live Mode and the show editor can reach.

The default, because it is the safe half. An account created without a role said is an account nobody decided to trust with the machine.

Everything an operator may do, and the machine itself.

Accounts, passwords other than their own, and the system settings — the Service Display's output among them. The first account a server has is this, because somebody has to be able to make the second.
